description: This PHP script is part of SuiteCRM's upgrade process, specifically the start.php file of the Upgrade Wizard module. It initializes the upgrade process, logs start messages, sets upgrade progress, handles optional update messages, and outputs HTML content for the upgrade start page.

methods.name: logThis
methods.description: Logs specified messages for debugging or audit purposes.

methods.name: set_upgrade_progress
methods.description: Sets the current status of the upgrade process.

methods.name: unlinkUWTempFiles
methods.description: Removes temporary files used during the upgrade process.

methods.name: resetUwSession
methods.description: Resets session variables related to the upgrade wizard.
